articles.title: Analyst Report: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc.
articles.mainIdea: Analyst Report: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc.
articles.summary: Morningstar Research: Analyst Report: Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc.. Huntington Ingalls Industries is the largest independent military shipbuilder in the US, spun out from Northrop Grumman in 2011. It operates three segments, two of which are storied shipyards: Ingalls produces non-nuclear-powered ships including amphibious landing ships and Arleigh Burke-class destroyers, while Newport News produces nuclear-powered ships as the only producer of Gerald Ford-class aircraft carriers and a major subcontractor on Virginia- and Columbia-class nuclear submarines. HII shares production of destroyers and nuclear submarines with General Dynamics' Bath Iron Works and Electric Boat shipyards, respectively. The company’s mission technologies segment produces uncrewed sea vessels and provides a range of IT and other services to US government agencies. Related tickers mentioned: HII.

articles.title: PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) approved in Canada for treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS)
articles.mainIdea: PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) approved in Canada for treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS)
articles.summary: CNW Group: PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) approved in Canada for treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS). UCB Canada Inc. is pleased to announce Health Canada has granted a Notice of Compliance (NOC) for PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) with an inadequate response to conventional systemic therapy.
